item: p1-02 SC-83 (AC-16d) 광물 X 의 MINERAL_DISCOVERED 정확히 1 · 근거 = 첫 채굴 · 증거 1
oracle_sql: select distinct on (payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id') payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id', tick, sequence, event_id from domain_events where world_id = '01a0ef85-f111-7a13-bb85-c92ad4522bd0' and event_type = 'MINERAL_MINED' and (payload->>'quantity_kg')::bigint > 0 order by payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id', tick, sequence;
